status: Research proposals, not implemented asset definitions

archetypes.name: Dedicated solar-row cleaner
archetypes.mechanism: Dry brushing with docking; some systems use their own solar supply.
archetypes.simulation: Soiling removal per section, finite coverage, brush condition, docking and weather limits.
archetypes.limits: Track/bridge layout; no automatic cross-row compatibility; consumables and servicing remain.

archetypes.name: Portable wet/dry cleaner
archetypes.mechanism: Battery-powered cleaner transported and operated by a person.
archetypes.simulation: Water, setup/movement labour, energy, coverage and cleaning effectiveness.
archetypes.limits: Remote control does not eliminate the operator or deployment visit.

archetypes.name: Mobile ground inspector
archetypes.mechanism: Visual, thermal, acoustic and optional gas sensing on taught inspection rounds.
archetypes.simulation: Travel graph, payload, observation quality, delay, charge, failed missions and assistance.
archetypes.limits: Mobility, gas-group rating and payload compatibility differ; a reading is not a repair.

archetypes.name: Docked aerial inspector
archetypes.mechanism: Repeatable visual/thermal survey with automatic dock charging.
archetypes.simulation: Survey coverage, wind/rain restrictions, flight reserve, dock power and delayed observations.
archetypes.limits: Weather, airspace/authorization and dock dependence; no generic gas identification.

archetypes.name: Contact inspection crawler
archetypes.simulation: Inspection method, reachable surfaces and measurement uncertainty.
archetypes.limits: Deployment and contact preparation may require people; requires a corresponding degradation model.

archetypes.name: Vegetation-management robot
archetypes.mechanism: Mapped autonomous mowing with recharge pod and remote monitoring.
archetypes.simulation: Seasonal growth, access obstruction, service hours, energy and human support.
archetypes.limits: Terrain, obstacles and robot maintenance; economics differ with site and climate.

archetypes.name: Sampling and analyzer station
archetypes.mechanism: Condition and route process or reference samples to an analyzer.
archetypes.simulation: Purge/transport delay, sample use, contamination, analyzer status and reference inventory.
archetypes.limits: Requires an analyzer, utilities and compatible process interfaces; not gas-quality certification.

archetypes.name: Automatic sensor service station
archetypes.mechanism: Retract, clean, validate and calibrate compatible pH/ORP sensors.
archetypes.simulation: Calibration age, reference/cleaner stocks, temporary unavailability and verified return.
archetypes.limits: Not a generic cure for a hydrogen flow meter; electrode and reagent replacement remain.

archetypes.name: Rugged fixed sensor package
archetypes.mechanism: Permanent ultrasonic, acoustic or intrusive measurements.
archetypes.simulation: Independent channels, battery life, drift, dropout and common-mode error.
archetypes.limits: Sensor coverage and calibration are bounded; no automatic remaining-life ground truth.

archetypes.name: Remote actuator / redundant service path
archetypes.examples: Rotork IQ3 Pro and shutdown options
archetypes.mechanism: Commanded actuation with position/torque feedback; optional stored-energy shutdown.
archetypes.simulation: Actuation power, stuck states, position uncertainty and service-path prerequisites.
archetypes.limits: Indication backup is not actuator motive power; valve action must have a modeled physical effect.

archetypes.name: Mobile maintenance manipulator
archetypes.mechanism: Valve manipulation, tooling and material handling.
archetypes.simulation: Tool/reach/torque compatibility, multi-stage tasks, failure, verification and remote assistance.
archetypes.limits: Manufacturer page explicitly says prototype; no universal consumable-replacement capability.

archetypes.name: Robot-compatible replaceable module
archetypes.mechanism: Single-axis guided insertion, combined latching and compliant mechanical interfaces.
archetypes.simulation: Service-port compatibility, spare stock, isolation, swap and post-service check.
archetypes.limits: Space-habitat lab hardware is evidence for a design principle, not pressure-system qualification.

archetypes.name: Solar construction robot
archetypes.mechanism: Mechanized panel handling, assembly and installation alongside construction crews.
archetypes.simulation: Build-phase labour, rented equipment, mobilization, capacity commissioning and defects.
archetypes.limits: Not a daily O&M robot; module installation is only part of project completion.

archetypes.name: Pre-integrated deployable solar array
archetypes.mechanism: Transportable pre-wired solar blocks unfolded with a small crew and machinery.
archetypes.simulation: Transport, installation time/cost, footprint and compatible cleaning/access geometry.
archetypes.limits: A design alternative rather than an autonomous robot; crew and telehandler still required.
